Target: inner PR p1 ("p1: t"), implemented. Worktree /wt at hb; the PR's base commit is b-contract. The contract is /s/contracts/p1.md. Rules file: none. When that is a path, read it before anything else (standing rules and test limits); it binds you.

Change: run the gates and report what they print. You repair nothing. Run, in this order: (1) every command in the contract's Gates section; (2) with `npm test --`, the unit folders (under src) that hold a test this PR adds or changes, and the unit folders next to the production files it changes; (3) the extra suite, `none`: when that is none, skip the gate and write "skipped: no extra suite" as its line in the table; otherwise run it as its own run, exactly as written; (4) the lint gate, `npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d "$BASE" -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' | xargs -r npx eslint`: when that is none, skip the gate and write "skipped: no lint command" as its line in the table; otherwise run it from the worktree root with BASE=b-contract exported, so it lints and type-checks the files the PR changes; (5) the frozen paths, none: when that is none, skip the gate and write "skipped: no frozen paths" as its line in the table; otherwise `git diff --stat b-contract HEAD -- none` must be empty unless the contract says otherwise; (6) a replay of the mutation ledger, when /s/ledger/p1/ledger-r1.md exists: in a throwaway copy (`git -C /wt worktree add --detach /s/work/p1/validator/wt HEAD`, removed at the end; unless `ln -s /wt/node_modules node_modules` is none, run it inside the copy first), apply each r1 patch alone, run the test the ledger names for it with `npm test --`, and compare with the recorded result. Write /s/reviews/p1/validator.md. Its first line is `VERDICT: PASS`, or `VERDICT: FAIL <gate>` naming the first gate that failed. Below it, a table: command, exit code, last line; then the failing lines of any gate that failed. Then write the pull request body to /s/pr/p1.md from the contract: what the PR does and why, in three sentences; the contract's rows with their status; the "Must not" items with the test that guards each; the gate table; the mutation counts; and the line "Part of #7" (never "Closes"). Ids and counts only: no tenant name, agent title or message text.

Constraints: no repair, no edit, no commit, no push: the worktree's HEAD and its uncommitted files must be the same when you finish. Never re-run a gate with a flag removed, a test deselected or a marker added to make it pass. The full unit suite is not yours to run. No GitHub write.

Ownership: /s/reviews/p1/validator.md, /s/pr/p1.md and /s/work/p1/validator/.

Observable acceptance: validator.md exists with its VERDICT line first, and the PR body exists. Send worker_done with --outcome succeeded when you ran every gate, whatever the verdict, and put the verdict line in the body. Report failed only when a gate could not be run at all.
